title: Kill transpose bank conflicts with +1 padding
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
Launched as a single 1D block of 1024 (32*32) threads; threadIdx.x is manually split into (row, col) since this simulator's CUDA-C frontend only carries .x through threadIdx/blockIdx/blockDim.
smem_wave_ratio is measured shared-memory waves divided by the conflict-free lower bound the grader computes itself.
